market_summary: Cross-market USD and risk-off momentum dominated the European session, pushing Gold, US100, and BTCUSD into extended sub-VAL downtrends below their respective VWAPs and EMA50 baselines. However, multiple assets (US100, BTCUSD, and XAUUSD) have just printed climatic sweeps of Session Lows accompanied by strong lower wicks and initial mean-reversion pauses right ahead of the New York cash open. Maintaining HOLD across all pairs to avoid selling into stretched ATR channel bottoms.

signals.rationale: Price is trading well below VAL (3950.76) and below POC (3978.40) in clear trend expansion into low-volume nodes. CVD is -7.18 (BEARISH) with strong negative slope (-2.42), confirming directional sell pressure. Market is in LONDON_NY_OVERLAP with expanding ATR envelope. Signal candle closed deep below the lower ATR band (3921.67) backed by an RVOL > 2.0 volume spike (2.164). However, the signal candle printed a significant lower shadow testing Session Low (3904.99) and the forming bar is retracing upwards toward 3912.66; selling into the extreme oversold extension right at support without a retest of broken S/R (3924.30) presents poor micro-location.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish / steep slope below session VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: acceptance below lower ATR band and test of Session Low 3904.99

signals.rationale: Price is positioned below VAL (1.32599) and below POC (1.32738). CVD is -8,746 (BEARISH) with strong downward slope (-3401.31), agreeing with the lower trend during LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price broke down below the EMA50 (1.32680) and VWAP (1.32659), and attempted rallies have been rejected cleanly at the S/R 1.32661 / Prev Low 1.32618 band. The last closed bar tested the lower ATR band (1.32506) with elevated RVOL (1.922, following recent yellow spikes). However, price is caught tightly between resistance at 1.32618 and major multi-touch Session Low support at 1.32500, offering inadequate clearance before support.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish / capped below VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: rejection of S/R 1.32661 and Prev Low 1.32618

signals.rationale: Price remains below VAL (28081.85) and well below POC (28120.74). CVD is -4.66 (BEARISH) with negative slope (-0.87), aligning with the overall intraday downtrend in the LONDON_NY_OVERLAP session. While price is trading below VWAP (28125.73) and EMA50 (28138.40), the signal bar completed a sharp flush and liquidity sweep down to Session Low 27912.13 before violently snapping back inside the ATR channel, closing at 27983.79. The forming candle is pushing up to test overhead S/R at 28030.00. Given the conflicting signals between the sharp sweep-rebound and the macro-downtrend, holding for NY cash open direction is prudent.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish / below declining VWAP and EMA50 baseline
signals.level_event: rejection of S/R 28030.00 after sweeping Session Low 27912.13

signals.rationale: Price trades below VAL (73260.85) and POC (73517.38) in a strong downward trend under VWAP (73425.21) and EMA50 (73333.54) during LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. CVD is -0.06 (BEARISH) confirming selling pressure. Volatility has expanded heavily past the lower ATR band (72510.56) initiated by a massive yellow RVOL > 2.0 bar on the previous impulse. However, the last closed bar and forming bar show a consolidation bounce from the Session Low sweep (72155.80) with candles forming long lower wicks and returning above the lower ATR band to 72554.20. Chasing a short into this oversold bounce off the session low carries high risk of a mean-reversion squeeze toward EMA20/VWAP.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish / steep decline under VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: breakout below Prev Low 73097.30 and test of Session Low 72155.80
